reviews.title: Great Performance
reviews.comment: I am thoroughly impressed with the Thermalright FW 240 SE ARGB. I installed it on my Ryzen 9 5900x, and the performance has been outstanding. My idle temperatures are hovering right around 30°C, and even when pushing the CPU under a heavy load, I haven't seen it go past 75°C. That's fantastic cooling power for such a demanding processor. The installation process was pretty straight-forward, if you know how to work on computers it shouldn't take you long. It seems like a very sturdy, well built, cooler which is great for the price. On top of the excellent performance, the aesthetics are a huge plus. The ARGB lighting looks clean and vibrant, but the real standout is the customizable screen. Being able to put custom images and stats on the pump head is a really cool feature, and it looks amazing inside my glass panel case. For the price, the combination of top-tier cooling and premium features like the screen is hard to beat. I'd highly recommend this cooler to anyone looking for great performance without sacrificing style.
reviews.author: John

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.comment: My son is building a computer. I bought his computer pieces all off of Amazon. He has built a thing from scratch. Every piece we bought him so far except for one was a perfect fit. We had to return one of them and get the proper fit but we got it and every piece has worked very well and in good work and condition for the price it's definitely worth it! I recommend.
reviews.author: 🎀PrettyInPink🎀

reviews.title: Easy install and temps look good!
reviews.comment: Great aio at a crazy price...i7 13th gen idles around 37c. Software works as expected, but saving gif "themes" is kind of tricky...(save theme is under video edit section that pops up). Other than that been great so far and ez to install. Did note it felt "light" compared to my evga 240mm aio, but not sure that's a tell for anything..Installed on an Asus G16CH case that didn't have aio from factory and fits like a glove. A+
reviews.author: Sacramento, CA

reviews.title: Keeps CPU Cool, but Screen Does Not Work for Linux
reviews.comment: Thermalright is a great brand. They make quality products at extremely competitive prices. I used this on a 9700X and 9600X build and in both cases it kept the CPU super cool. However, the software for the included screen is not the greatest, and as far as I can tell does not work on Linux, which is why I am only giving 4 out of 5 stars. Otherwise comes with all hardware you need and works excellently.
reviews.author: Nicholas U.

reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.comment: Love the fact that the fans were already installed on the radiator. Saved some time. The software for the screen is a little janky but it works. Cooler works great.  Highly recommended. Easy to install. Looks great.
